args.script:
#!/bin/bash
TARGET_DIR="$HOME/linux_problem/sample_dir"

# Count regular files (not hidden)
file_count=$(find "$TARGET_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -not -name '.*' | wc -l)

# Count directories (not hidden)
dir_count=$(find "$TARGET_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type d -not -name '.*' | wc -l)

# The total sum
total=$((file_count + dir_count))

echo "$total"
